projects.title: Budget Sasa ni Delivery
projects.subtitle: National budget explainer series
projects.briefChallenge: Translate FY2026/27 national budget priorities into language young citizens could share on social feeds without losing fiscal accuracy.
projects.whatWeProduced: A presenter-led explainer package with bilingual cut-downs, chapter markers, and caption-ready vertical exports.
projects.description: BNS Studios produced a flagship explainer anchoring Treasury's 'delivery' narrative to verifiable allocation lines. Field segments from town halls were intercut with motion graphics built from National Treasury published tables — no synthetic scaling of figures.

impactEvidence.primaryMetric: 480K+ views across YouTube and social in 90 days
impactEvidence.context: Distribution through BNS Connect youth network and partner civic pages.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: View counts aggregated from platform analytics dashboards.

projects.title: Budget Ndio Story Podcast
projects.subtitle: Season 1 — fiscal deep-dives
projects.briefChallenge: Create a recurring audio home for budget scrutiny that journalists and youth could cite between news cycles.
projects.whatWeProduced: Eight-episode season with studio interviews, field ambiences from county forums, and syndication-ready mastering.
projects.description: Recorded at BNS production sessions with fiscal researchers and youth trackers. Each episode anchors to a verifiable Treasury or county document cited in show notes.

impactEvidence.context: Cross-promoted on BNS TikTok and Learn Hub modules.

projects.title: Nakuru Citizen Budget Baraza
projects.subtitle: Town hall design & broadcast
projects.briefChallenge: Design a participatory forum where county officials and residents could interrogate CAIP priorities with documented follow-up.
projects.whatWeProduced: Facilitation runbook, stage design, tri-camera livestream, and edited highlight reel for county channels.
projects.description: BNS facilitated a three-hour baraza with simultaneous translation lanes and live note-taking published as a citizen-readable summary within 48 hours.

impactEvidence.context: County assembly clerk acknowledged proceedings in Hansard reference.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: Attendance register and stream analytics on file.

projects.title: Finance Bill Motion Graphics
projects.subtitle: 2D animation package
projects.briefChallenge: Explain contested Finance Bill clauses to first-time voters without partisan framing.
projects.whatWeProduced: Three animated chapters covering revenue measures, exemptions, and citizen recourse pathways.
projects.description: Animation storyboards were reviewed by fiscal policy researchers. All figures sourced from published bill text and CRA summaries.

impactEvidence.context: Released during Finance Bill debate window.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: Partner-reported reach; BNS retained raw analytics screenshots.

projects.title: Mashinani: Promise vs Delivery
projects.subtitle: Short documentary
projects.briefChallenge: Document how youth trackers verify county project claims against site visits and published estimates.
projects.whatWeProduced: 18-minute documentary following trackers in Kakamega and Kilifi with parallel budget desk verification.
projects.description: Shot over six weeks with consent protocols for community participants. No budget figures appear without on-screen source attribution.

impactEvidence.context: Used as opener for Mashinani scorecard launches.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: Event programmes and attendance logs retained.

projects.title: CRA Third Basis Formula Spotlight
projects.subtitle: Research multimedia digest
projects.briefChallenge: Package a 40-page CRA technical report into assets policymakers and journalists could use in one sitting.
projects.whatWeProduced: Animated data walkthrough, printable brief, and moderated panel recording with economists.
projects.description: All charts rebuilt from CRA published tables. Spotlight launched alongside Wanahabari Lab session for journalists.

impactEvidence.primaryMetric: 85 journalists trained in linked Lab session

projects.title: Budget Mtaani TikTok Series
projects.subtitle: Vertical social campaign
projects.briefChallenge: Reach 18–30 year-olds with county budget facts they would actually share.
projects.whatWeProduced: 20-episode vertical series with hook-first scripting, on-screen source citations, and consistent BNS visual identity.
projects.description: Filmed with youth presenters at county forums and studio pick-ups. Each episode links to a Learn module or report for depth.

projects.title: Wajir Community Listening Sessions
projects.subtitle: Arid lands budget dialogues
projects.briefChallenge: Capture ground-level budget priorities in Wajir where formal town halls under-represent pastoralist communities.
projects.whatWeProduced: Four listening circles with audio documentation, translated summaries, and photo essays for county assembly submission.
projects.description: Sessions held in Ward hubs with female and youth quotas for speaking time. Outputs fed into Mashinani scorecard evidence.

impactEvidence.context: Equalisation Fund line items referenced in summaries.

projects.title: Budget Policy Statement 2026 Coverage
projects.subtitle: Multi-format newsroom kit
projects.briefChallenge: Give journalists a same-day toolkit when the BPS dropped — charts, quotes, and b-roll they could air immediately.
projects.whatWeProduced: Same-day explainer, clean b-roll package, and slide deck synced to Treasury tables.
projects.description: Produced in 36-hour sprint with Wanahabari Lab alumni. All figures matched Treasury PDF line items.

impactEvidence.primaryMetric: 9 newsrooms used kit in week one
impactEvidence.context: Distributed via Wanahabari Lab alumni list.

projects.title: National Stakeholder Forum Production
projects.subtitle: Hall event broadcast package
projects.briefChallenge: Document a multi-stakeholder fiscal forum for donors needing evidence of convening quality.
projects.whatWeProduced: Multi-camera coverage, highlight documentary, and stakeholder interview series.
projects.description: Full technical production in partnership hall venue. Deliverables supported a grant reporting cycle for the convening funder.

impactEvidence.context: Forum on national fiscal transparency agenda.
impactEvidence.verificationOutcome: Registration data provided by convening partner.
